calls.statement:
WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period)
SELECT s.format,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores,
       COUNT(*) AS line_rows
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period = params.fiscal_period
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'fact_all_stores<900_incl_staff' src, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) receipts, SUM(f.net_amount) net_before_returns
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id<900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'control_rpt', SUM(receipts), SUM(net_sales_before_returns) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE store_id<900 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'fact_staff_only', COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), SUM(f.net_amount)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id<900 AND f.staff_purchase_flag AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
UNION ALL
